title: E-RLT-0045: rotation symmetry does not come back at coarse scale under the committed rule: the rule keeps no...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0045 in the relativity arena: rotation symmetry does not come back at coarse scale under the committed rule: the rule keeps no rotation, so rank 2 is the lowest unforced rank (the torus group forces it, W(F4) forces rank 4 too, the rule's own {I, -I} forces nothing), and the rank-2 response of long charge waves stays anisotropic from side 9 to 17 (kernel 1.60, 1.34, 1.31, axis-shell spread 0.31, 0.33, 0.34), keeping over 0.8 of itself where a lattice correction would keep 0.53 or 0.28, against a streaming floor of a few hundredths.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
